points.description: Gives the way 'nonconstant pointer to constant data' (e.g., pointer to const data such as const T* p; the pointer itself may be changed, but the pointed-to data may not be modified through it). Accept equivalent const notation or wording.
Gives the way 'nonconstant pointer to nonconstant data' (e.g., T* p; both the pointer and the pointed-to data may be modified). Accept equivalent wording.
Gives the way 'constant pointer to constant data' (e.g., const T* const p; neither the pointer nor the pointed-to data may be modified). Accept equivalent const notation or wording.
Gives the way 'constant pointer to nonconstant data' (e.g., T* const p; the pointer itself may not be changed, but the pointed-to data may be modified). Accept equivalent const notation or wording.

rubric.notes: Full marks require all four const/non-const combinations of pointer and pointed-to data. Each correct combination earns its point; a vague answer that only says 'pass a pointer' without distinguishing const on the pointer and on the data earns no marks. Equivalent const notation or wording is acceptable.
